title: connectSortBy wipes it's sortBy setting when it is the default.

comments.body: We ensure the default index doesn't show up in ui state, but instead gets applied in getWidgetSearchParameters so that the default index case doesn't need to be handled in routing (as most the default state of any widget doesn't show up in the url). If we'd have that in ui state, you'd either need to remove it in stateToRoute or have an update of the URL on first load of the page.
Fair enough - but that isn't made clear in the custom routing documentation where it is implied the uiState of each widget should be fully populated out.
Which documentation do you mean? happy to update it with a suggestion that would be clearer for you!

This page: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/going-further/routing-urls/js/

The section on rewritingURL's manually is the one that should make mention of it. I got the impression that I had to account for all aspects of the uiState.

And this isn't your team's fault - I just assumed. But documentation is a tricky thing.

Thank you for your time. After reading over this note please close.
I've added a note to that page, thanks. This issue will close once the PR in the documentation is merged automatically.
